Everything else the standards and spec reviews raised that this lane was not obligated to fix in code (ADV-L02-07, ADV-L02-09, ADV-L02-11, L02-SPEC-03, L02-SPEC-05, L02-SPEC-06, L02-SPEC-07, L02-SPEC-08) is unchanged and still correctly deferred (hosted census, integrator's from-scratch chain, owner rulings, or documentation-only), and none of it is newly broken. findings.title: 0338 SS-E's dual-shape install (the ADV-L02-01/ADV-L02-02 fix itself) fails the WB-R21 wiki-authority-boundary lint gate: no DYNAMIC_SQL_ALLOWLIST waiver was added for clara._obo_plan_core's new dynamic install path
findings.evidence: `node scripts/check-wiki-dynamic-sql.mjs` (real exit code 1, confirmed by redirecting to a file rather than a pipe, since piping through `tail` masks the exit code): "0338_prepayment_close_standing_instruction.sql:708  dynamic function-creating `do` block -> clara._obo_plan_core(text,uuid,uuid,uuid,text,text,jsonb,text,text,integer,text,date,date,jsonb) -- the INSTALLED body runs a RECONSTRUCTIBLE dynamic statement ... whose transitive reach cannot be PROVEN wiki-free ... it needs a justified DYNAMIC_SQL_ALLOWLIST waiver". This did not exist before the fix round: the base branch's SS-E was a single static `create or replace function`; the fix for ADV-L02-01/ADV-L02-02 (commit aaaa82e8c) replaced it with `do $c0338_e$ ... if to_regprocedure('clara._assert_plan_authority(...)') is null then ... execute $c0338_e_pre$ create or replace function ... $c0338_e_pre$; else ... execute $c0338_e_post$ create or replace function ... $c0338_e_post$; end if; end $c0338_e$;` -- a dynamic function-creating statement, which is exactly the class scripts/check-wiki-dynamic-sql.mjs exists to catch. scripts/wiki-lint-checks.mjs's own DYNAMIC_SQL_ALLOWLIST docstring ("TWENTY ENTRIES as of 2026-09-20") shows the established remedy for a genuinely non-wiki but unprovable statement: a reviewed waiver entry keyed by exact signature, with a live-measured `relations`/`calls` set and a `prosrc !~* '\ywiki'` confirmation. No such entry was added for `_obo_plan_core`. `CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint` therefore fails at this stage independently of the pre-existing frozen-workflow drift (RECHECK-note below).
findings.required_fix: Either (a) add a reviewed DYNAMIC_SQL_ALLOWLIST entry for clara._obo_plan_core(...) in scripts/wiki-lint-checks.mjs, following the established pattern: measure the LIVE installed body's relations/calls set on the rig, confirm `prosrc !~* '\ywiki'`, and write the `why`; or (b) redesign SS-E to avoid the dynamic `do`/`execute` pattern (for example, two separate static `create or replace function` statements each gated by its own top-level `if ... end if` around a normal DDL statement rather than a dynamically executed string, if the migration runner's DDL-in-a-conditional semantics allow it). Re-run `node scripts/check-wiki-dynamic-sql.mjs` to confirm exit 0 before this lane merges.
